chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Rayyan ibn al-Salt, who said:
I heard al-Ridha (peace be upon him) say: Allah has never sent a prophet except with the prohibition of wine and that he acknowledge to Allah the Bada’.

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Ridha (Imam al-Ridha, peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What are the two essential attributes of all prophets according to Imam al-Ridha?
ai.summary: Imam al-Ridha (peace be upon him) establishes that the proclamation of 'al-Bada’'—the divine manifestation of change in decree or knowledge—is a universal hallmark of all prophets, alongside the prohibition of wine. This hadith underscores the theological significance of Bada’ in Shia doctrine, linking it directly to prophetic mission and the dynamic nature of Allah’s will. It highlights how this concept serves as a key differentiator in understanding divine omniscience and predestination within the Ahl al-Bayt tradition.

en.ammaar-muslim: 7. [7/365] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from his father from al-Rayyan b. al-Salt who said:
I heard al-Ridha عليه السلام: Allah has never appointed a prophet except with the prohibition of wine and that he (the prophet) accept from Allah the Bada’
